### What's Wrong?

The best next step is to report it at https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues — mention that:
  - Windows 11, terminal (CLI)
  - Voice was working, stopped in last couple days
  - Holding space just types spaces instead of activating voice
  - /voice shows enabled, logged in with Claude.ai account

  That'll help them track it down. Not much more we can do from this side unfortunately.
